items.issue: enterDetailsHeadingText (line 36) was added so specs could share the heading format, but no spec calls it: both specs moved to the enterDetailsCounterHeading locator, and a grep of tests/, flows/ and page-objects/ finds its only caller at line 42. The PR therefore adds a public string method with one caller, inside the same class, around a template that enterDetailsCounterHeading already held inline. The house rule is that a literal used by one function lives in that function.
items.fix: Must: the 'Enter details for {latinName} {current} of {total}' format has one home, with no public member that nothing outside the class uses. One way: put the template back inline in enterDetailsCounterHeading and delete enterDetailsHeadingText; if a spec later needs the raw text, extract it then.
items.notes: Reverses our 29 Oct advice: that review suggested adding enterDetailsHeadingText so specs could share the text. Nothing outside the class needs it now.
